children: was upgraded at BofA Securities on robust Connect unit volumes and lower valuation.
The stock was raised to Neutral from Underperform, and the price objective was increased to $49 from $31.
Shares were 2.73% higher at $39.31 during morning trading on Wednesday.

"We hiked our PO multiple to 25x from 17.5x, driven by a stronger revenue growth outlook into 2028 following recent momentum at Figure Connect," said analysts Craig Siegenthaler, Kareem Seif, Eli Abboud, and Ivory Gao.

"FIGR generated 132% year-over-year volume growth in Q2, and Figure Connect, its blockchain-native loan marketplace, contributed 65% to total volumes vs. 42% a year ago," said the analysts in a research note.

"The FIGR stock had an unusual upward move to $78 from Q4 2025 into January 2026, which caused us to downgrade the stock to Underperform, mostly driven by valuation, which drove downside to our PO," said the research note.

"Following the rating change, the stock had a quick, unusual downward move into the $25 to $35 range. This wide swing moved the stock valuation from 40x to 15-20x 2028 with the PE multiple cut in half," said the note.

title: Figure Technology upgraded at BofA Securities on Connect volumes, valuation
